criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/review-brief-planted-faults/ invokes /vloop:review-brief on a scaffolded repository holding a draft brief that plants three faults: a fact about the code that the scaffolded code contradicts, a literal value the Behaviour contract and the Worked example state differently, and a configured check that fails after the first task and stays red until the last. Its graders, of any documented type: one that the verdict is not PASS; one per planted fault that it is named (three); one that the brief is not edited. Graders that could all pass with a planted fault missed, or with the brief edited, are a violation.
criteria.evidence: scaffold.sh plants GREET_NAME claim (bin/greet does not read it), usage message differing between contract and example, and tests/golden.sh red after task 1. Graders: verdict-not-pass, names-fact, names-literal, names-red-check, plus Edit and Write max 0 on the brief.

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/create-brief-drafts-checked/ invokes /vloop:create-brief on a scaffolded repository with a request that settles every fork, states every literal value, and says the independent review is out of the case. Its graders read the trace, not a file: a tool_used Bash grader for `vloop brief new` and one for `vloop brief check`, each min 1; a regex grader on the trace for the check's `0 warning(s)` (vloop brief check prints it on its own line, `  ok, 0 warning(s)`, after the per-check lines); an llm grader with `focus: trace` that the brief written has `status: draft`, an executive summary, and the request's literal values verbatim. Graders that could pass with no brief written are a violation.
criteria.evidence: prompt.md settles every fork and excludes the review; graders brief-new, brief-check (tool_used Bash, min 1), check-clean (regex, target trace, 'ok, 0 warning\(s\)'), brief-content (llm, focus trace). brief-new and brief-check need a brief attempt; brief-content scores 0 without a brief.

criteria.criterion: Both cases follow plugin/evals/README.md and docs/guide/evals.md: case.yaml declaring the scaffold, prompt.md with max_turns and allowed_tools holding at least the work fence's grants, graders of the documented types; every Bash grant either case names is in the guide's --allow-tools list. TestPluginSkills and TestEvalGrantsCoverFence pass in the `go` check with the two cases, no check weakened.
criteria.evidence: Both cases have case.yaml, scaffold.sh, prompt.md with max_turns and allowed_tools, graders of types llm, regex, tool_used. Guide list gained 'Bash(vloop brief:*)'. Go check log exit 0; no test changed in the diff.

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/README.md's table of other cases gains a row for each: `| `review-brief-planted-faults` | `/vloop:review-brief` | … |` and `| `create-brief-drafts-checked` | `/vloop:create-brief` | … |`.

docs/guide/evals.md says the full suite is `21 cases × 3 runs × 2 arms`; its "vloop's suites" table gains a row each for /vloop:create-brief (create-brief-drafts-checked), /vloop:review-brief (review-brief-planted-faults), /vloop:verify (verify-planted-mismatches) and /vloop:operate (operate-proposes-options); the line "`/vloop:operate` has no suite: it is the operator's, interactive." is removed. No other existing case changes.
criteria.evidence: docs/guide/evals.md diff: 16 changed to 21 (21 case directories exist), four rows added, the no-suite line removed. git status shows no existing case directory modified.

notes: The review-brief-planted-faults brief says 'Two to two tasks', an incidental oddity that does not affect the planted faults.
